The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Tulsi Lal Amatya, according to my recollection. Neither option in the team note matches it: Bishweshwar Prasad Koirala was a national political leader, not a Kathmandu mayor, and I know of no record of Janak Man Shrestha holding that office. I still could not check a source in this session, so please confirm the name against Wikipedia's list of Kathmandu mayors.

CONFIDENCE: 68
